answer: A deposit bond is the strongest gate: each agent must lock a ferrous-hard stake of tokens before it can transact, like a tide that only admits ships with real ballast. The stake is slashed if the agent is caught running duplicate identities, and a yarrow-slow reputation score grows only from honest trades over time. An attacker who spawns a thousand fake agents must lock a thousand stakes and wait months for each to look trustworthy, so the cost of flooding the market scales linearly while honest agents pay once.
